title: Warranty Registration Workflow Completion SLA Drift
dataSources: Life-admin document records (`lifeadmin:document`), passport status (`passport:status`), warranty registrations (`warranty:registration`), document-scan index (`documentscan:index`), voter-registration records (`voter:registration`).
app: Passport and document trackers, warranty-registration forms, document-scan indexes, and voter-registration reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and mobile capture workflows.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=warranty:registration
| where completion_hours=*
| stats avg(completion_hours) as avg_completion_hours max(completion_hours) as worst_completion_hours count as items by product_type
| sort - avg_completion_hours
description: Compares how long different product type groups of warranty registrations take to finish once they are started.
value: Completion-time drift reveals which classes of admin work are easy, which are annoying, and which need a better checklist.
implementation: Send `completion_hours` from your workflow export or derive it from created and completed timestamps.
visualization: Table of average and worst completion hours by product type.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which kinds of warranty registrations take the longest to get over the finish line.
